name: FirstInternships private resume upload handoff
description: A user-controlled handoff for college students who want to place one PDF resume in the private FirstInternships Talent Network and optionally enable AI-assisted opportunity matching.
audience: Authenticated college students age 18 or older
user_actions_required: Authenticate with Google or a passwordless email link
Select the resume PDF in the FirstInternships interface
Provide the minimum required matching fields
agent_instructions: Use this handoff only after the person explicitly asks to upload or join the Talent Network.
Open the handoff URL and let the person complete authentication, file selection, and consent.
Do not transmit the resume to any undocumented endpoint or claim that an upload completed without visible confirmation.
Do not claim a match, qualification, interview, offer, or employer access.
Explain that employers cannot browse the pool and that a named opportunity requires separate approval before sharing.
direct_upload_explanation: FirstInternships intentionally requires a user-controlled authenticated browser flow for resume files and consent. There is no anonymous or agent-held upload credential.
